title: Shared shopping list UI
lead: The shared list both phones use: add, check, remove, staples one-tap, ordered by category (L1, L4).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sending the list to a store; offline editing.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This is the second everyday screen. Items anyone adds from the kitchen must show up on whichever phone is used to place the order.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
None if the list interview is done. Confirm the final wording of buttons with the owner.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, ADR 0020 (S23): phones poll every few seconds, no live push; checked items are struck through until 'Clear'; the list resets with a manual 'Ordered' button, not weekly; free-text items are allowed; one category order for every store. The final button wording is still to confirm with the owner.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, from S22: the Today view links to /list, so S25 registers the list page at the path /list.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. List page grouped by category; large checkboxes; a sticky add box at the top.
2. Progressive enhancement: plain forms work without JS; JS polls a version endpoint and re-renders the fragment.
3. Staples drawer with one-tap add.
4. "Ordered" action as decided in ADR 0020.
5. Show "added by" subtly (from the device's person).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Web tests pass; two browsers see each other's changes within the polling interval.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
